steps.domain_action: Initialize the system with the void of unclassified integers before any depth-k split.
Fork the domain into two distinct reading modes: dense forward and sparse backward.
Apply the forward morphism of the shortcut Collatz map k times on the dense reading.
Evaluate the affirmative state of the dense reading, identifying survivor classes that do not contract.
Chain the affine shift identity to link the residue class to its iterate in the forward direction.
Fix the topological invariant of the forward reading, recording the survivor density decay.
Apply the reverse morphism to compute predecessors in the sparse reading, descending the tree.
Evaluate the negative state of the sparse reading, certifying that every path is a finished trajectory.
Chain the predecessor arithmetic to link the target to its predecessors in the backward direction.
Fix the topological invariant of the backward reading, recording the trajectory certification.
Hold both the decaying density of survivors and the growing density of certified trajectories simultaneously in a paradice.
Rejoin the two readings into a single state defined by the conserved integer winding number.
Recognize the object as self-complementary, holding both dense and sparse readings within a single register.
Close the boundary with the scale-collapse where surface and interior become a single register.
